notes: A walkable aquarium: step inside Fernwick Aquarium and stroll a hall of ten themed exhibits, from Lily Cove and The Deep to a round brass porthole for the Legends of the Lake. Every fish you donate swims in its tank.
Finish an exhibit for a one-time coin reward (150 to 600). Exhibits you filled before this update pay out on your first visit.
Benches in front of the tanks (sit a while for a little luck), and two neighbours drop in each day to marvel at your discoveries.
New badge: Curator, for completing five exhibits (27 in all).
Fernwick has more character: a tin roof with a fish weathervane, a scalloped bakery roof with a dormer, a copper cupola, a thatched cottage, swinging shop signs, doorstep plants and softer shadows.
The street dresses up for each season: bunting in spring and summer, leaf garlands and pumpkins in autumn, wreaths and twinkling string lights in winter. Mabel's window display changes too.
Fixed the library chimney floating above its roof.
